summary: Re-tested the Quick Guide Phase 1 fix for the HIGH feedback-persistence race from iteration_49. All 5 requested flows pass. The functional-updater refactor in QuickGuideProvider.jsx and the useMemo-derived voted state in GuideFeedback.jsx eliminate the last-write-wins race — feedback IS now persisted to IndexedDB across reload, last-vote-wins flips correctly between helpful_ids and not_helpful_ids, derived state syncs across close/reopen without reload, Shopping Mode IRR-1100 flow (previously skipped) is now verified with a seeded Grocery note, and the analytics_buffer preserves all three event types (guide_opened + guide_feedback + guide_closed) in a single session.
critical_code_review_comments: MINOR (non-blocking): The fire-and-forget saveSettings inside persist() creates brief windows where an IDB read taken immediately after a persist call (e.g. within ~500ms of open()) may not yet reflect the newest analytics_buffer entry — the value later shows up correctly because subsequent functional-updater persists rebuild from the up-to-date React state and include every prior event. Not user-visible, but if a future test asserts on IDB state RIGHT after open() without any subsequent action, it may see an empty analytics_buffer. Consider awaiting the storage write or returning the promise from persist() if this matters for future flows.

MINOR: Hydration's terminal `await StorageService.saveSettings({[QG_STORAGE_KEY]: loaded})` can race with an early user click that opens a guide before hydration's async save completes; because the fix keeps every write functional (built from the latest state) the final IDB snapshot is still correct, but the intermediate 'after open, before further action' snapshot may reflect the hydration write instead of the open event. Same non-user-visible artifact as above.

rca_of_the_issue: iter_49 bug root cause: persist() was `useCallback([state])` closing over `state`, called sequentially with a second `_bufferEvent(state,...)` right after. The second call rebuilt next={...state,...patch} from the STALE state closure (pre-vote) and clobbered the just-written feedback. Fix (applied in this iteration): persist() now uses `setState(prev => ...)` and returns the derived snapshot; bufferEvent/recordFeedback/close/markSeen all use functional updaters or single combined snapshots. GuideFeedback additionally uses useMemo(state.feedback) instead of useState-lazy-init, so no local drift after reopen. Verified: reload→reopen→navigate-to-card-5 shows correct voted button (green ring + check svg) AND IDB helpful_ids=['IRR-1000'], AND analytics_buffer contains all 3 event types after open+vote+close.
